channel.title: Texas Legislature - Today's Filed Bills in the Senate
channel.description: Bills filed on 11/16/2026. An appearance of a bill on this list is a result of it being filed by a representative or senator.

item.title: SB 396 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Campbell
item.description: Relating to the qualifications of a trustee authorized or appointed to exercise the power of sale of real property under a security instrument.

item.title: SB 397 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Zaffirini
item.description: Relating to the regulation of stormwater management by certain counties.

item.title: SB 398 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Zaffirini
item.description: Relating to a study by the Department of State Health Services regarding the human health risks associated with exposure to hydrogen sulfide.

item.title: SB 399 Introduced
item.dc:creator: West
item.description: Relating to a local option exemption from ad valorem taxation by a municipality or county of the total appraised value of certain residence homesteads that do not have access to potable drinking water.

item.title: SB 400 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Zaffirini
item.description: Relating to collective bargaining rights and procedures for certain employees of a political subdivision.

item.title: SJR 16 Introduced
item.dc:creator: West
item.description: Proposing a constitutional amendment to authorize the legislature to provide for a local option exemption from ad valorem taxation by a municipality or county of the total appraised value of a residence homestead that does not have access to potable drinking water.
